services.desc: For river fishing we use a 17′ Hyde drift boat. We have a forced air heater for those cold winter days. A drift boats special design allows for shallow draft and nimble performance when navigating the rivers of the Olympic Peninsula in Seattle, WA. Our Saltwater charter boat is a 2005, 24-foot Alumaweld Formula Vee. She is powered by twin Yamaha 150hp 4 stroke with 300hp which means we are first to the fishing grounds! A spacious cabin and a large fishing cockpit give our anglers plenty of room for fighting fish. blurb: Tyee Charters offers daily Salmon fishing trips departing from Seattle or Bainbridge Island. We offer 6hr morning trips and 4hr afternoon trips to suit your trip needs. Puget Sound is a unique area to fish for Salmon, LingCod, and Halibut. With sweeping views of the Cascade and Olympic mountains, Seattle and Mt Rainier. Puget Sound is for the most part very calm water making for a great Seattle fishing charter
